launcher.notes: KINETRIX LAUNCHER 3.0.5 - LAUNCH BLOCKER FIXED + TASKBAR ICON STAYS. A stale filename inside the update manifest (kinetrix-3.16.1.jar listed under the mod-v3.16.2 release) made the pre-launch client update fail with HTTP 404 after 3 retries and blocked every launch - the manifest is now cross-checked against its own version, a mismatching filename is repaired from the release's real asset list, and if the download URL is ever rejected (or a checksum disagrees) the launcher re-resolves the newest release from the actual GitHub release assets before giving up, so a bad manifest can no longer stop you from playing (already fixed live on the channel too - today's 404 is gone even on v3.0.4). The taskbar icon no longer disappears: with close-after-launch the window is hidden while the game runs, and on Windows re-showing it that way could drop the taskbar button - the window is now restored and the taskbar entry is re-registered every time it reappears. Everything from 3.0.4 is unchanged: the hard pre-launch client gate, Modrinth + CurseForge browser, Microsoft sign-in, Quick Play, cosmetics locker and full crash doctor.

client.notes: KINETRIX CLIENT 3.19.0 "PHOTOSMOOTH" - REFERENCE-GRADE RENDER CONFIGURATION. The entire UI now renders through an analytic anti-aliased vector pipeline: every panel, button, slider, tile and rounded image is drawn as a signed-distance field with hermite-eased edge coverage, so corners, hairlines and outlines come out photographic instead of pixelated - same GUI shape and layout everywhere, radically sharper. Window shadows moved to the wide box-gradient depth profile (50% edge alpha, 64px linear feather at 1080p) and the GL alpha test is disabled around the AA pass so soft edge pixels are never clipped into crunchy stairs. Glyph baking fixed: the shape anti-aliasing hint was inverted, so all fonts now bake with true anti-aliased edges at every size, and the font cache is OOM-safe on low-memory machines. The LIVE studio capture is supersampled at 1920x1080 (JPEG 0.94, adaptive grab rate), the resolution scaler gained HD/Ultra/Max tiers up to 2560x1440, and the real-time ClickGUI editor ships in the box (v3.18.0 LiveGUI: click once on any element in the real client and edit it live - modules, toggles, sliders, colors, keybinds, plus global style: horizontal/vertical padding, section/tile gap, columns, radius, opacity, accent hue, font scale, panel width). Version footer fixed (was stale at 3.18.1). Obfuscated production jar (ProGuard + string-pool scramble) verified on Forge 1.8.9 + OptiFine HD U M5: launch, title render, world join and screenshots all pass.
